changelog:
Initial release of libvips-image: high-performance image processing skill.

- Fast, memory-efficient image operations via libvips/pyvips.
- Supports resize, crop, thumbnail, convert, rotate, watermark, composite, batch processing, and more.
- CLI tools for scriptable workflows, cross-platform run scripts for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Comprehensive install instructions with "one-click" scripts and support for uv/pip.
- Handles many formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, PDF, SVG, RAW, and more.
- Ideal for large images and batch pipelines with low memory overhead.
summary: High-performance image processing with libvips. Use for resizing, converting, watermarking, thumbnails, and batch image operations with low memory usage.
